name: Digarr (selfhosters)
description:
Self-hosted music discovery for your library. Find artists and albums from
    your listening history, review recommendations, and send approvals to
    Lidarr or slskd. Generate playlists for connected services, or run without
    Lidarr. Use a hosted AI provider or your own local model.

    Ships with a built-in embedded database -- no separate PostgreSQL
    container needed. Data is stored in the mapped data folder
    (/mnt/cache/appdata/digarr/data) and automatic pre-migration backups in
    the mapped backups folder (/mnt/cache/appdata/digarr/backups); both must
    be writable by the container user (uid 1000). To use an external
    PostgreSQL instead, set the (advanced) Database URL variable.
requires:
No separate database required -- uses a built-in embedded database by
    default. The data and backups folders (/mnt/cache/appdata/digarr/data and
    /mnt/cache/appdata/digarr/backups) must be writable by the container user
    (uid 1000). Optionally point Database URL at an external PostgreSQL
    instance.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Persistent storage for the built-in embedded database. Must be writable by the container user (uid 1000).

paths.name: Backups
paths.description: Persistent storage for automatic pre-migration backups (the last 14 are kept). Must be writable by the container user (uid 1000). Without this mapping, backups are lost when the container is recreated.

variables.name: Data Path
variables.description: Container path for the built-in embedded database (matches the Data folder mapping)

variables.name: Database URL
variables.description: Leave empty to use the built-in database. Set only to use an external PostgreSQL, e.g. postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/digarr. Percent-encode username, password, and database-name components (pass#word becomes pass%23word; a literal % becomes %25), not the whole URL. Keep the original password in PostgreSQL password settings.

variables.name: Initial Username
variables.description: Set with Initial Password to create the first admin. Leave both blank for manual registration. Ignored when users already exist.

variables.name: Initial Password
variables.description: Set with Initial Username, using at least 12 characters. Ignored when users already exist; does not reset passwords.

variables.name: AI Provider
variables.description: AI provider: anthropic, openai, gemini, ollama, openai-compatible (or configure in UI)

variables.name: AI Model
variables.description: Exact model ID offered by your configured AI provider

variables.name: AI API Key
variables.description: API key for the AI provider

variables.name: AI Base URL
variables.description: Base URL for openai-compatible or ollama (e.g. http://ollama:11434)

variables.name: Lidarr URL
variables.description: Lidarr instance URL, e.g. http://lidarr:8686 (optional -- discovery works without Lidarr)

variables.name: Lidarr API Key
variables.description: Lidarr API key (Settings > General in Lidarr)

variables.name: ListenBrainz Username
variables.description: ListenBrainz username for taste analysis

variables.name: ListenBrainz Token
variables.description: ListenBrainz user token

variables.name: Last.fm Username
variables.description: Last.fm username for taste analysis

variables.name: Last.fm API Key
variables.description: Last.fm API key

variables.name: Allowed Origin
variables.description: Exact public origin for cookies, CSRF, and SSO callbacks, e.g. https://digarr.example.com (no trailing slash)

variables.name: Allow Insecure Cookies
variables.description: Cookies default to Secure in production, even behind a TLS-terminating proxy. Set true ONLY for an intentional direct-HTTP deployment (pair with an http:// Allowed Origin); direct HTTP exposes the session cookie to interception.

variables.name: Encryption Key
variables.description: Random key (32+ characters recommended) for encrypting API keys, tokens, and connection passwords (blank stores those fields unencrypted)

variables.name: Disable Registration
variables.description: Set to false to allow local password registration. OIDC account provisioning is controlled by the identity provider

variables.name: Skip TLS Verify
variables.description: First-run auto-setup TLS setting; afterward change saved connection settings in the UI

variables.name: Webhook URL
variables.description: First-run env auto-setup webhook (requires AI_PROVIDER and AI_MODEL); afterward configure channels in Settings

author: selfhosters
